label: Non-denominational church
framing: Frame for a non-denominational church audience: accessible, Christ-centered discipleship with local-church autonomy. Prefer a shared evangelical baseline (NAE Statement of Faith) plus common network affirmations used by many independent churches (e.g. ARC Statement of Faith; Destiny Leaders / Destiny Ministries What We Believe)—paraphrase only; do not invent a denominational handbook.
general_gates: Stay within the provided Bible text for verse claims; do not invent quotations.
Do not invent primary-source citations beyond the digests and identifiers supplied in this pack (NAE, ARC Statement of Faith, Destiny Leaders What We Believe).
When citing doctrine, prefer those published statements—paraphrase only.
When a doctrinal stance gate matches, state the tradition, the stance (yes/no/conditional/pastoral/silence), and any required conditions clearly.
Note that many non-denominational churches are legally autonomous; local practice may vary on secondary issues.
For sensitive life topics, encourage prayer and trusted pastoral or professional help; AI is not a substitute for counseling.

citation_map.note: Bible as inspired, infallible, authoritative Word of God. Cite NAE Statement of Faith; ARC Statement of Faith; Destiny Leaders — Authority of Scripture.
One God eternally existent as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Cite NAE; ARC; Destiny Leaders — God.

Jesus Christ true God and true man; virgin birth, sinless life, atoning death, bodily resurrection, return; salvation only in His name by grace through faith. Cite NAE; ARC; Destiny Leaders — Lord Jesus Christ / Doctrine of Man.

articles: We believe in the Holy Spirit
citation_map.note: Holy Spirit convicts, regenerates, indwells, gifts, and empowers; Destiny and ARC affirm baptism with the Holy Spirit for empowerment and gifts available today—avoid inventing local evidence rules. Cite ARC Statement of Faith; Destiny Leaders — Work of the Holy Spirit.

Local church gathers for Word, fellowship, gifts, and care. Ordinances include water baptism and the Lord’s Supper; Destiny also affirms holy matrimony as an ordinance. Cite NAE; ARC — local church; Destiny Leaders — In the Church.

Marriage as holy monogamous union of one man and one woman; sexual intimacy reserved for that covenant; compassion and dignity for every person. Cite ARC Statement of Faith — matrimony; Destiny Leaders — Marriage / Christian Conduct.

articles: We believe in the personal return
citation_map.note: Personal return of Christ in power and glory—avoid date-setting. Cite NAE; ARC; Destiny Leaders — Lord Jesus Christ.

primary_sources.title: NAE — Bible & God (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: The Bible is the inspired Word of God and final authority. Evangelicals confess one God eternally existing in three persons—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

primary_sources.title: NAE — salvation & Spirit (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ. The Holy Spirit indwells and empowers believers for holy living and witness.

primary_sources.title: NAE — Church & hope (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: The Church is the body of Christ. Local churches practice baptism and the Lord’s Supper under Scripture. Christ will return personally—avoid date-setting.

primary_sources.title: ARC — Statement of Faith core (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: ARC affirms the inspired, infallible Bible; one God in three coequal persons; Jesus’ virgin birth, sinless life, miracles, crucifixion, burial, resurrection, and return; salvation only in Jesus’ name; mankind sinful apart from the gospel; Holy Spirit’s convicting, regenerating, gifting work and baptism with the Holy Spirit for empowerment; and the local church for Word, fellowship, gifts, correction, and care. ARC churches remain legally autonomous.

primary_sources.title: ARC — marriage (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Matrimony is a holy monogamous marriage between one man and one woman—two distinct genders reflecting God’s image and nature.

primary_sources.title: Destiny Leaders — What We Believe (digest)
primary_sources.cite: Destiny Leaders / Destiny Ministries What We Believe (paraphrase); destinyleaders.com/about
primary_sources.excerpt: Destiny Leaders confesses one true God revealed as Father, Son Jesus, and Holy Spirit; Scripture as inspired, infallible, and authoritative; Jesus’ sinless life, miracles, atoning death, bodily resurrection, ascension, and imminent return; humanity created in God’s image yet lost in sin and saved only through faith in Christ’s blood; the Holy Spirit empowering holy living, witness, and gifts for today; and the Church as all who believe and are regenerated by grace.

primary_sources.title: Destiny Leaders — marriage, life, compassion (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Destiny Leaders teaches male and female as complementary creations reflecting God’s image; marriage as one man and one woman; sexual intimacy only within that covenant; every person owed compassion, love, kindness, respect, and dignity; and the sanctity of human life from conception through natural death. The Bible remains final authority for faith and practice.

primary_sources.title: Churches In Covenant — network posture (digest)
primary_sources.cite: Churches In Covenant public mission/vision (paraphrase); churchesincovenant.org
primary_sources.excerpt: Churches In Covenant presents itself as a relationship-based community strengthening pastors and ministries through mentoring, peer coaching, gatherings, and decentralized delivery of biblical doctrine and spiritual leadership—not as a creedal denomination. When a visitor identifies with CIC, keep Scripture-first non-denominational evangelical framing and point sensitive questions to pastoral counsel rather than inventing a CIC confession.

stances.summary: Bible as inspired, infallible, final written authority (NAE / ARC / Destiny).
Salvation by grace through faith in Christ alone; Jesus the only Savior.
Water baptism as ordinance following faith; local church administration.
Lord’s Supper as ordinance/memorial with spiritual communion by faith.
Speak as Lord’s Supper/ordinance, not transubstantiation.
Lifelong covenant of one man and one woman (ARC / Destiny).
Serious; pursue reconciliation and pastoral counsel.
Depends on biblical grounds and church guidance.
Faithfulness in marriage; chastity otherwise; compassion and dignity for all.
Local congregation under Scripture; many networks leave churches autonomous.
Holy Spirit baptism/empowerment affirmed in ARC and Destiny; local evidence teaching may vary—do not invent tongues-as-required rules unless the selected network pack says so.
